verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HRIS integration and data rooms for file sharing, but nothing about scoped, permissioned third-party access (e.g., law firms, wealth managers) short of full admin credentials — no mention of role-based access controls, guest/advisor accounts, or API scoping for external parties. Missing for 10: any documentation of third-party/advisor roles, scoped permissions, or API access controls limiting data visibility for external collaborators.
